messages:
sunita: quick design pass — thinking about a compact run-history row that surfaces structured-output actions. can we add a single-click "Run with schema" button and a keyboard shortcut? attached mock (img)

owen: +1 on the button. question: is it context-aware? if the schema is defined in the function defs panel, the button should default to that. otherwise open the schema editor inline.

kai: mock idea: small chevron on the run row expands an action tray: [re-run] [run with schema] [download json] [view diff]. keyboard shortcut suggestion: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R for "run with schema". keeps Enter/Cmd+Enter as normal run.

mike: accessibility nits: make sure the action tray is focus-trap friendly, tabindex order predictable, and each button has aria-labels like "Run with schema (opens schema selector)". visible focus ring for keyboard nav. also check color contrast for the chevrons — current light gray fails AA.

sunita: good call. also thought about showing a tiny pill that indicates "schema mismatch" if the last run produced output that doesn't validate. hover reveals errors. that reduces surprise for non-dev users.

owen: UX concern: we need to avoid overwhelming the run-history row. maybe hide less-used actions behind a kebab menu and surface only "re-run" and "run w/ schema" by default.

kai: implementation note for eng-runtime: when user hits "run with schema" we should prefer client-side validation first (fast fail) and then run on server if passes. small code example in the mock:

```js
// pseudo
const result = validate(output, schema)
if (!result.ok) showInlineErrors(result.errors)
else callPlaygroundRun(payload)
```

mike: small copy tweak: change label to "Run with schema (validate then run)"? maybe too verbose. suggestion: "Run (with schema)" or tooltip that says "Validates output against schema before running".

sunita: love "Run (with schema)" as a compact label. for the pill states: success (green check), invalid (orange warning), error (red). pinging @owen @kai for visual phrasing + spacing guidance.

playground-bot: deploy-preview available at https://playground.redwood.example/pr/632 — includes action-tray mock and keyboard shortcut handler.

owen: I'll open a quick Figma file and annotate spacing + motion. main concerns: motion for expanding tray (reduce layout shift), and mobile/touch hit targets.

mike: one more a11y thing — ensure the schema selector supports typeahead and clear labels for nested fields. screenreader should announce "schema selector collapsed, 3 schemas available" when focused.

sunita: thanks all — next step: @owen to update Figma, @kai to prototype client validation + shortcut handler, @mike to write an a11y checklist we can run against the preview. landing doc: will add to playground UX RFC. :todo:
